gen-fs-red-hat-display-archivo: Marker-bold and open. Red Hat Display draws its heading with a uniform stroke, while Archivo sans keeps its curves flaring outward and stands tall on a commanding x-height.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-clash-grotesk: Cheerful, direct, and friendly. Red Hat Display holds one steady marker line with daylight in every curve, and Clash Grotesk gives the text a flat, unmodulated stroke you can size up a touch.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-alpino: Alpino reads cozy and a bit squat, its tall body making ascenders look short. Red Hat Display handles the smooth, plotter-like heading work, and Alpino keeps the casual text feeling snug with curve endings held well apart.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-familjen-grote: Lively and slightly unfinished. Red Hat Display glides along with strokes that never fatten on the downstroke, while Familjen Grotesk brings tall lowercase and bowls left open on one side.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-karma: Red Hat Display moves with a skimming ease, its stroke never changing weight. Karma's text serif then settles in with a mild, letterpress-like modulation and terminals clear of the stem, so a long passage feels trustworthy.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-literata: Red Hat Display keeps one line width through every curve and straight, like a marker on paper. Literata serif is the bookish counterpart, with thin strokes only slightly slimmer than its stems.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-merriweather-s: Merriweather Sans brings tall, sturdy lowercase and an e whose eye opens clearly to the right. Red Hat Display, drawn like spaghetti laid out in letters, leads above it, and a long passage in the sans would feel large and clean.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-roundo: Roundo reads geometric and unclogged, with every small counter kept clear. Red Hat Display does its best work as a bold marker-line heading, while Roundo is built for text, its n having matching arch and stem.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-carme: Carme reads modern and spaghetti-thin, with counters leading outward. Red Hat Display's marker-like heading hands over to a body where a longer passage would flow smoothly, without a snag.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-domine: Red Hat Display bends each letter like a single wire. It earns its keep big and brief, while Domine serif adds dignity with tall lowercase and a tempered contrast.
